programs.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
programs.desc: Agathe, a shy employee of the Shakespeare \u0026 Co. bookstore.in Paris, dreams of romantic love like in a Jane Austen novel and success as a writer.An invitation to England gives her a chance to change her fate.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: The Housewives of the North Pole
programs.desc: Friends Trish and Diana (Betsy Brandt) win the competition for the best Christmas home decoration every year.When they break off the relationship after a quarrel, they take part in the struggle as rivals.

programs.title: Brandy Hellville \u0026 the Cult of Fast Fashion
programs.desc: An Italian company founded in the 1980s, Brandy Melville, is a typical example of a fast fashion brand.There is a toxic culture behind photos of very young models showing off their clothes.
